newsitem.title: GREECE: Banks, OTE telecom pull Greek shares 0.48pct up.
newsitem.headline: Banks, OTE telecom pull Greek shares 0.48pct up.

text.p: Greek shares gained 0.48 percent to 1,543.23 in quiet Wednesday trade on upbeat banks and OTE telecom.

"Banks fared slightly better than other stocks today because they met with light volumes on the supply side and investor interest was attracted by press reports on more aggressive privatisation in the sector," said Constantine Lygizos, analyst at Egnatia Securities.
A local daily said the government was contemplating speeding up the rollback of the state from the banking sector, leaving a small number of state-controlled banking institutions.

"The market is very quiet at the moment due to the vacation season," Lygizos said. "Foreign portfolios are not active in Greece at the moment because there are better plays in bullish mature international markets."
Local investors shrugged off statements by the U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday, indicating that American interest rates would remain steady for some time, brokers said.
The Athens general index advanced 0.48 percent or 7.42 points to 1,543.23 from Tuesday's 1,535.81 close, trading within a narrow eight-point range.
Banks added 0.68 percent, while industrials failed to capitalise on their early gains and slipped 0.18 percent.
Small-caps were also down but all other sectors finished higher.
Turnover reached 10.3 billion drachmas on volume of 2.7 million shares.
Block trading included OTE telecom, 200,000 shares at 6,245 drachmas, Alpha Leasing, 2x 50,000 shares at 7,320/50, and Hellenic Biscuits, 100,000 shares at 3,000.
Advancers led decliners 102 to 94 with 28 shares unchanged on 224 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted on London's SEAQ International market at $10.5-$10.9. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas, capped at 5,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,118-1,148 drachmas.

The recently launched second Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,060-1,120 drachmas. The warrants expire December 16, 1998. Shares of the underlying stock gained 65 drachmas to 6,265.
The Merrill Lynch American call warrant on a basket of 23 Greek equities that are part of the Athens general index was quoted at 595.41-633.42 drachmas. The warrants expire January 9 1998.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $65.44-$68.12. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.

The ING Baring Financial Products American-style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 3,136-3,351 drachmas. The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.
The ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $10.13 bid/no offer. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style, drachma- denominated call warrant on the bourse's benchmark index was quoted at 211-242 drachmas. The strike price is set at 1,639 points and the warrants expire May 14 1998. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
